WELCOME TO CODE LAB

A whole toolbox of ideas.

  1. Motion: add Move, then put a purple direction in its socket.
  2. Control: Repeat runs a body a number of times. Repeat until checks its condition before each lap. If / Else chooses a branch. Wait pauses for seconds.
  3. Sensing: Path clear?, At exit? and Facing? read Pip’s world. “Path clear ahead” uses Pip’s current facing.
  4. Operators: combine conditions with And, Or, Not. Compare numbers using =, ≠, <, >, ≤ or ≥. Drag number reporters into numeric sockets.
  5. Variables: create a named counter, Set it or Change it. Move count, batteries and keys are automatic, read-only counters.
  6. My blocks: create a definition, fill its body, then call it from your program. Calls can be reused inside loops and decisions.

Tap a highlighted insertion slot or input socket, then tap a toolbox block. Dragging works too. Select a block’s + to insert before it; × removes it. Undo restores your last edit. Changing a program resets the robot. Reset keeps your code and clears run-time values.

Step executes one highlighted block, including condition checks and calls. Run follows the same rules. A Wait block finishes its delay before the next Step is available. Pause freezes that delay. A rescue succeeds when the program ends at the exit with the room’s required key. Runaway programs stop after 2,000 block executions; custom calls may nest 24 deep.
